SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

2. Which statement about Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage as rumours only.
   B. Explain Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage.
   D. Say Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Weather and Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Weather and Climate as rumours only.
   B. Explain Weather and Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate.
   D. Say Weather and Climate never happens in Kenya.

   B. Say The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui.
   D. Treat The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui as rumours only.

6. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

7. Which statement about Population distribution in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Population distribution in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Population distribution in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Population distribution in Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Say Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about School administration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain School administration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say School administration never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing School administration.
   D. Treat School administration as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Development of Transport is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Development of Transport with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Development of Transport never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Development of Transport.
   D. Treat Development of Transport as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Mining in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Mining in Kenya.
   B. Treat Mining in Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Explain Mining in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Mining in Kenya never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites never happens in Kenya.

   D. Skip evidence when discussing Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites.

   A. Skip evidence when discussing African Traditional Education.
   B. Explain African Traditional Education with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say African Traditional Education never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat African Traditional Education as rumours only.

14. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

15. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

16. Which statement about Location, Position and Size of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Location, Position and Size of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Location, Position and Size of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   D. Skip evidence when discussing Location, Position and Size of Kenya.
